name: Intel Xeon 6788P specifications
notes: Intel ARK spec page. 86 cores / 172 threads, 2.0 GHz base, 3.2 GHz all-core turbo, 3.8 GHz max turbo, 336 MB cache, TDP 350 W, 4 UPI at 24 GT/s, 8 memory channels, DDR5-6400 only (no MRDIMM line), max memory 4 TB, FCLGA4710, scalability 4S/8S, 88 PCIe 5.0 lanes, AMX present, lithography Intel 3, launch Q1'25, RCP $21,280. Same core count and channel count as 6787P; the difference that matters for the 4-socket MLPerf rows is the 8S scalability.
